items.q: Which number is bigger, 61 or 38? Write the bigger number.
items.hint: Look at the tens first. 6 tens or 3 tens?
steps: 61 has 6 tens and 1 one.
38 has 3 tens and 8 ones.
6 tens is more than 3 tens, so 61 is bigger.

slips.say: 38 has the bigger ones digit, but only 3 tens. Look at the tens first.

tpl.q: Which number is bigger, {a} or {b}? Write the bigger number.
tpl.hint: Look at the tens first. {t1} tens or {t2} tens?
steps: {a} has {t1} tens and {o1} ones.
{b} has {t2} tens and {o2} ones.
{t1} tens is more than {t2} tens, so {ans} is bigger.

items.q: Which number is smaller, 52 or 29? Write the smaller number.
items.hint: Look at the tens first. Which number has fewer tens?
steps: 52 has 5 tens and 2 ones.
29 has 2 tens and 9 ones.
2 tens is fewer than 5 tens, so 29 is smaller.

slips.say: 52 is the bigger number. Look for the one with fewer tens.

tpl.q: Which number is smaller, {a} or {b}? Write the smaller number.
tpl.hint: Look at the tens first. Which number has fewer tens?
steps: {a} has {t1} tens and {o1} ones.
{b} has {t2} tens and {o2} ones.
{t2} tens is fewer than {t1} tens, so {ans} is smaller.

items.q: You have the digit cards 7 and 2. What is the biggest number you can make?
items.hint: Put the bigger card on the left.
steps: The left card counts the tens, so we want the bigger card there.
Put 7 on the left and 2 on the right.
The biggest number is 72.

slips.say: 27 is the smallest number. For the biggest, put the bigger card on the left.
9 is 7 + 2. Put the cards side by side to make a two-digit number.

tpl.q: You have the digit cards {x} and {y}. What is the biggest number you can make?
tpl.hint: Put the bigger card on the left.
steps: The left card counts the tens, so we want the bigger card there.
Put {x} on the left and {y} on the right.
The biggest number is {ans}.

items.q: You have the digit cards 7 and 2. What is the smallest number you can make?
items.hint: Put the smaller card on the left.
steps: The left card counts the tens, so we want the smaller card there.
Put 2 on the left and 7 on the right.
The smallest number is 27.

slips.say: 72 is the biggest number. For the smallest, put the smaller card on the left.

tpl.hint: Put the smaller card on the left.
steps: The left card counts the tens, so we want the smaller card there.
Put {y} on the left and {x} on the right.
The smallest number is {ans}.

items.q: You have the digit cards 3 and 8. Which two numbers can you make?
items.hint: Put the cards side by side, then swap them.
steps: 3 on the left makes 38.
8 on the left makes 83.
You have one 3 and one 8, so the numbers are 38 and 83.

slips.say: You have only one 3 and one 8. Each card is used once in a number.

items.hint: Look at the tens first. Then look at the ones.
steps: 63 and 60 have the most tens: 6 tens.
Compare their ones: 3 ones is more than 0 ones.
63 is the biggest.

slips.say: 60 and 63 both have 6 tens. Look at the ones to decide.
36 has only 3 tens. Look for the most tens.

items.q: You have the digit cards 0 and 6. What is the only two-digit number you can make?
steps: A number does not start with 0, so 06 is just 6.
Put the 6 on the left and the 0 on the right.
The only two-digit number is 60.

slips.say: 06 is just 6, not a two-digit number. The 0 can not go on the left.

tpl.q: You have the digit cards 0 and {x}. What is the only two-digit number you can make?
steps: A number does not start with 0, so 0{x} is just {x}.
Put the {x} on the left and the 0 on the right.
The only two-digit number is {ans}.

items.q: You have the digit cards 2, 5 and 8. Use any two cards. What is the biggest number you can make?
items.hint: Which card is the biggest? Put it on the left. Then pick the biggest card that is left.
steps: The biggest card is 8. Put it on the left.
The biggest card left is 5. Put it on the right.
The biggest number is 85.

slips.say: 58 has the 5 on the left. Put the biggest card on the left.
You have only one 8. Each card is used once.

tpl.q: You have the digit cards {x}, {y} and {z}. Use any two cards. What is the biggest number you can make?
tpl.hint: Which card is the biggest? Put it on the left. Then pick the biggest card that is left.
steps: The biggest card is {z}. Put it on the left.
The biggest card left is {y}. Put it on the right.
The biggest number is {ans}.

items.q: You have the digit cards 0, 4 and 9. Use any two cards. What is the smallest two-digit number you can make?
items.hint: The 0 can not go on the left. What is the smallest card that can go on the left?
steps: 0 can not go on the left. The smallest card for the left is 4.
The smallest card for the right is 0.
The smallest two-digit number is 40.

slips.say: 04 is just 4, not a two-digit number. Put the 0 on the right.
49 is a two-digit number, but 40 is smaller. Use the 0 on the right.

tpl.q: You have the digit cards 0, {y} and {z}. Use any two cards. What is the smallest two-digit number you can make?
tpl.hint: The 0 can not go on the left. What is the smallest card that can go on the left?
steps: 0 can not go on the left. The smallest card for the left is {y}.
The smallest card for the right is 0.
The smallest two-digit number is {ans}.

items.q: You have the cards 1, 3, 5 and 7. Two different cards make a two-digit number. It is more than 40. The left digit is bigger than the right digit. How many numbers fit?
items.hint: List the numbers that are more than 40. Then cross out the ones where the left digit is not bigger.
steps: Cross out 57, because 5 is not bigger than 7.
Left: 51, 53, 71, 73, 75. That is 5 numbers.

slips.say: 6 includes 57. Check clue 2 for every number.

items.q: You have the digit cards 3, 5 and 7. Use all three cards to make a 3-digit number. What is the biggest number you can make?
items.hint: The left card counts the hundreds. Put the biggest card on the left, then the next biggest.
steps: The biggest card is 7: put it on the left.
The next biggest is 5, then 3.
The biggest number is 753.

slips.say: 357 is the smallest number. For the biggest, put the biggest card on the left.

tpl.q: You have the digit cards {x}, {y} and {z}. Use all three cards to make a 3-digit number. What is the biggest number you can make?
tpl.hint: The left card counts the hundreds. Put the biggest card on the left, then the next biggest.
steps: The biggest card is {z}: put it on the left.
The next biggest is {y}, then {x}.
The biggest number is {ans}.

items.q: You have 4 different digit cards, none of them 0. How many two-digit numbers can you make with two different cards?
items.hint: How many choices for the left card? Then how many choices are left for the right card?
steps: 4 choices for the left card.
Then 3 cards are left for the right card.
4 x 3 = 12 numbers.

slips.say: There are more than that. For each left card there are 3 choices for the right card.
16 lets a card be used twice. Here each card is used only once.

tpl.q: You have {n} different digit cards, none of them 0. How many two-digit numbers can you make with two different cards?
tpl.hint: How many choices for the left card? Then how many choices are left for the right card?
steps: {n} choices for the left card.
Then one fewer card is left for the right card.
That makes {ans} numbers.

items.q: You make a 3-digit number with the cards 2, 5 and 8, each used once. It is more than 500 and less than 600. The ones digit is bigger than the tens digit. What number am I?
items.hint: List all the numbers you can make. Cross out the ones that break a clue.
steps: More than 500 and less than 600: 528 and 582.
Ones digit bigger than tens digit: 528.

slips.say: 582 has a 2 in the ones place and an 8 in the tens place. Check the third clue.

items.q: Make up your own digit card puzzle with 2 clues (more than a number, and left digit bigger than right digit). Check which numbers fit.
items.hint: Pick four cards first. List every number you can make. Then write clues.
steps: List every two-digit number from your cards.
Check each clue, and cross out the numbers that break it.
For example, with the cards 2, 4, 6 and 8: more than 50, and the left digit is bigger than the right. The numbers are 62, 64, 82, 84, 86. That is five numbers.
